settings.title: Settings
settings.host_pattern: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.host_format: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.web_description: Manage filters, upstream DNS servers, clients and access settings in the AdGuard Home web interface. Log in with the user and password below.
settings.doh_url_helper: Use this URL as encrypted DNS server in browsers and on phones.
settings.dns_bind_hosts_helper: IP addresses of this node where DNS is served on port 53, separated by commas. 0.0.0.0 listens on all IPv4 and IPv6 addresses. Clients outside private networks are refused until you allow them in AdGuard Home (Settings > DNS settings > Access settings).
settings.unspecified_address_must_be_alone: 0.0.0.0 or :: listens on all addresses and cannot be combined with other addresses
settings.ip_address_not_on_node: This address is not configured on this node
settings.dns_port_in_use: Port 53 is already used by another DNS server (for example a Samba domain controller or dnsmasq). Choose other addresses
settings.new_admin_password_helper: Leave empty to keep the current password.
settings.password_too_long: Must be at most 72 bytes long
settings.admin_password_maxLength: Must be at most 72 characters long
